  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The second-parent check in `_is_must_contain_resolver_union_merge_false_positive` passes vacuously when `other_line == merged_line`, because `_only_inserts` returns `[]` (not None) and every inserted run is a substring of the line itself.
  WHY: A resolver that takes the other side's line verbatim can pass the gate with only a warning. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and qwen rated it MAJOR, while glm rated it NIT (confidence 3) and argued that no revert is demonstrated. The highest rating is used. All four suggest adding `other_line != merged_line`.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:739-747 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The resolver-union check searches history with `git log -S<literal> --first-parent --max-count=1`, but a valid union keeps the whole captured literal intact. Its occurrence count does not change across the resolver commit, so that commit is not a pickaxe hit.
  WHY: The search lands on the earlier sub-issue commit instead, so the helper returns None and the original missing-pattern violation stands and blocks the wave.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:779-782 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `all(run in other_line for run in inserted)` is a per-run substring test, so short runs such as "|" or " " are substrings of almost any line.
  WHY: Text the resolver added itself can pass, which weakens the "resolver added nothing of its own" guarantee. Only very short inserted runs reach this case.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:662-678 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `difflib.SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False)` runs on every line longer than the captured literal, with no cheap pre-filter.
  WHY: The cost is roughly quadratic in line length, but the impact is bounded: the check runs only on a resolver-merge pickaxe hit and results are cached.

  WHY: The gate is meant to fail closed when the resolver reverts sub-issue intent.   PROBLEM: The substring test per inserted run lets short runs pass if they occur anywhere in the second-parent line.

- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:`merged_line` loop calling `_only_inserts` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: difflib runs on every longer line with no pre-filter.
  WHY: Impact is bounded by the narrow trigger and by caching.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add `other_line != merged_line and` to the condition, plus one regression test. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
